title: Scoped validate reports a known issue

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: demo/ open in Godot 4.3+ (mono), addon enabled, bridge running. This scenario proves the verify path reports a known demo issue code (not a flaky failure). It stages a copy of the committed broken-reference fixture under _ValidationSuite/m10-gate-fail/ and does NOT instantiate it as the main scene. validate_edit runs read-only on the live bridge.

steps.title: Run a scoped validate over the staged fixture
Expected outcomes
items: validate_edit returns isError: false and reports the scoped scan ran.
The issues list contains the code broken_scene_reference (from the broken_references rule).
Severity is Error, matching the shipped rule catalog.
No crash; a missing path returns a structured error rather than hanging.

reset.note: Deletes the staged fixture tree (_ValidationSuite/m10-gate-fail/). Canonical demo/Fixtures/ are untouched.
